title: David L NDE 385
content: I was swimming in a pool, with a friend. We had a large raft in the pool with us; we were playing like we were scuba divers. He left to use the bathroom and I kept on swimming. I went under water, my face mask came off and the chlorine was burning my eyes so I shut my eyes and came up for air. When I thought I was out of the water I gasped for air not knowing the raft was above me. I breathed in all water because the raft held me under when I took my breath. I freaked out and was thrashing around for air. My strength vanished quickly from all the thrashing around under the raft. I sank to the bottom of the pool with no strength left. My body was convulsing trying to get oxygen then after a bit, my body went still. All I could see was black all I could hear was my heart beating slower and slower. I remember praying, 'I don't want to die. Please God I don't want to die.' I started to cry, I know I was crying because the tears were warmer than the water. I could no longer hear my heart. Then I saw these things like huge bubbles, but they were not bubbles, they kept getting closer and closer. They hit me with extreme force and each time one would hit I would see a moment from my past when I was being mean or rude to someone but I saw it through their eyes and I could feel how I was making them feel. It was awful. One after another, they wouldn't stop, each bubble seemed to last forever and felt worse and worse. It was like watching a virtual reality video and feeling every emotion and physical pain. Then I saw my funeral and all my loved ones and how they felt from me being dead. I started to pray and had an understanding of some sort of what was going on. It was almost like a mini judgment of my life up to that point. Everything that I had said or done to hurt anyone was coming upon me. I continued to pray then all of a sudden this feeling of love came over me and I knew everything was going to be all right. God gave me the strength to lift up my arm and my friend grabbed it, pulled me out, and revived me.

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: Regained strength to lift arm; friend grabbed it, pulled him out, and revived him.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Drowning/near-drowning in a swimming pool after inhaling water under a raft.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Blackness/void; prayer; felt 'love came over me'; saw his funeral and loved ones' feelings.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: No OBE/tunnel/light reported; experience centered on darkness, distressing life-review-like episodes, then comforting love and physical rescue/return.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Life-review elements occurred as repeated 'huge bubbles' striking him with force, each triggering relived moments from others' perspectives; also reported tears felt warmer than the pool water.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I don't want to die. Please God I don't want to die.”; “Then all of a sudden this feeling of love came over me and I knew everything was going to be all right.”
